premises.text: Businesses use custom currency (gift cards, promo codes, refund credits) in targeted marketing to drive spend
premises.evidence_span: they can use custom currency in their targeted marketing to get you to their site and compel you to spend

premises.text: Enabling custom currency is hard because payment systems are not set up for tracking, access control, and associating promo value with gift cards and refunds
premises.evidence_span: enabling custom currency is actually really hard to do. It's complicated and payment systems aren't set up to do it well

premises.text: Merchants running their own online checkout must otherwise build a custom currency solution themselves
premises.evidence_span: you're stuck building your own custom currency solution yourself

premises.text: GiftBit SaaS provides a web app and API so businesses can create, distribute, and manage custom currency integrated with checkout
premises.evidence_span: web application and a powerful API to enable a business to have, distribute, and manage their own custom currency

premises.text: Marketing teams get tools to control, send, and track currency while developers integrate via a simple API
premises.evidence_span: marketing teams get all the tools they need to be able to control, send, and track their custom currency

premises.text: Pricing starts at $90/month for 1,000 active codes plus $15/month per additional 1,000 codes
premises.evidence_span: priced our product starting at $90 a month to make it accessible to businesses of any size

premises.text: Integrations with Shopify Plus and payment processors (Stripe, Braintree) extend merchant adoption
premises.evidence_span: We have an integration with Shopify Plus, and we're building out our Stripe and Braintree integrations as well

domains.name: custom currency need and build burden

value.text: Online businesses get flexible custom currency without building their own complicated stack
value.evidence_span: no one needs to build their own complicated custom currency because they have GiftBit
